sections.kicker: Prepared for VANDAÏRE by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: VANDAÏRE wrote a clear promise on Instagram. The site shows a beautiful bag and never says it.
sections.keep: The campaign film on the homepage. The bag in the city reads exactly as a work bag with softness.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: For women with ambition and softness
pins.what: Your best line lives only on Instagram.
pins.why: It names who VANDAÏRE is for, which is why a woman picks it over another black tote.
pins.how: Put this sentence on the site, over the film.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Visitors see a nice bag and compare it on price.

pins.quote: Complimentary shipping on all orders within Singapore
pins.what: The first words on the site are about shipping.
pins.why: The one line every visitor reads says nothing about the woman you design for.
pins.how: Give that first line to the brand, and let logistics sit lower.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: The first impression goes to a policy any shop can offer.

pins.what: The bio credits the bags to a person, the site does not.
pins.why: A founder behind the bag is a reason to trust a young brand.
pins.how: Decide whether VANDAÏRE speaks as a house or as its designer, and say it on both.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: The story behind the bag stays hidden on the site.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at VANDAÏRE. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Three things stood out, and all three point the same way.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on VANDAÏRE's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Cuyana, from fashion. It says who its bag is for in one line, and every image repeats it.
